# Replicating IAM's cell instruments (generated by CANON/replicate.py; do not edit by hand)

**One rule (author, 2026-10-15): the only code we send anyone to replicate is the full chain.** Side scripts in `development/` and in test
folders are exploration history; they are never the replication path. Every test logged from 2026-10-15 on runs through the chain and is
refused by the push gate otherwise (`CANON/chain_gate.py`).

## How to replicate (chain code only)

1. Clone the repository. The chain is `Biological_Physics/MethylPhys/chain/`; set up its environment from
   [`chain/requirements.txt`](chain/requirements.txt) (Python 3.11). Full cold start: [`chain/RUN_MANIFEST_and_README.md`](chain/RUN_MANIFEST_and_README.md).
2. Check the chain on its constructed tests: `python3 Biological_Physics/MethylPhys/chain/release_check_v3.py`.
3. Read a specimen: `python3 Biological_Physics/MethylPhys/chain/MethylPhys_Interface/run_sample.py` with
   `--grn`, `--red`, `--betas`, `--age`, `--specimen`, `--out`, `--id`, `--bundle`, `--covariate`, `--covariates`, `--no-bundle`, `--ledger`, `--sex`, `--patient-id`, `--array-type`, `--intake-log`, `--manifest-dir`, `--no-intake`, `--engine`, `--slide-ref-A`, `--slide-ref-table`, `--pat`, `--pat-max-bytes`, `--alignment-qc`, `--iama-ref-table`, `--dev-allow-partial`, `--site-table`, `--seq-pipeline`, `--seq-cell`, `--prior-betas`, `--prior-bundle`, `--save-betas`, `--dev-selftare-ii`, `--atlas-v2`, `--sesame-rscript`.
4. Every result the chain writes for a logged test carries a chain stamp (chain version, payload hash, inputs); compare yours with ours.

Chain entry points: `chain/conductor_v3.py`, `chain/stage_1_idat_calibration.py`, `chain/stage_q_iam_a.py`, `chain/stage_q0_intake.py`, `chain/stage_q2_selfref.py`.
